## Data: Korean Youth Panel Data (2016\~2020)

```{r Data_load}

library(haven)
library(tidyverse)

kypd <- read.table('/Users/seongminpark/Documents/GitHub/gganggang2.github.io/Personal Project/GMM_KUPD.dat', header = F, sep = "\t", na.strings = "-999")

colnames(kypd) <- c("STID", "t1", "t2", "t3", "t4", "t5", "x1",
                    "x2", "x3", "x4", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x8", "x9",
                    "x10", "x11", "x12", "x13", "x14", "x15", "x16",
                    "x17", "x18", "x19")

kypd <- kypd %>%
  mutate(across(c(x1, x2, x3, x4), as.factor))

kypd <- as.data.frame(kypd)
```

## Run SEMTree, based on the prior GMM result

Prior result suggests that the linear trajectory is an optimal shape for teacher-student relationship in terms of conflicts, hence my template model would be modeled as the linear shape as well.

```{r SEMTree}

library(semtree)
library(lavaan)
# library(partykit)

# LGM: Equality constraints for measurement error
# (CO)Variances are constraiend due to the negative variances

covariate_names <- paste0("x", 1:4)
#x1 : sex (0=female, 1=male)
#x2 : children's perceived parent's interest for their academic task
#x3 : level of parent's school participation 
#x4 : level of parent's interest in their children's school
#x2~x4 : If levels are high > interests and participations are also high

lgm_data <- kypd[, c("t1", "t2", "t3", "t4", "t5", covariate_names)]
lgm_data <- as.data.frame(lgm_data)

kypd_lgm <- '
  I =~ 1*t1 + 1*t2 + 1*t3 + 1*t4 + 1*t5
  S =~ 0*t1 + 1*t2 + 2*t3 + 3*t4 + 4*t5
  Q =~ 0*t1 + 1*t2 + 4*t3 + 9*t4 + 16*t5
  t1 ~~ a*t1
  t2 ~~ a*t2
  t3 ~~ a*t3
  t4 ~~ a*t4
  t5 ~~ a*t5
  Q ~~ 0*S
  Q ~~ 0*I
  Q ~~ 0*Q
'

fit_lgm <- lavaan(
  model = kypd_lgm, 
  data = lgm_data, 
  missing = "fiml",
  model.type = "growth",
  do.fit = FALSE
)

summary(fit_lgm, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
lavInspect(fit_lgm, "cov.lv")


# SEMTree


control_settings <- semtree.control(
  method = "fair",        
  max.depth = 2,
  min.N = 10,
  alpha = 0.05,
  exclude.heywood = T
)

kypd_tree <- semtree(
  model = fit_lgm, 
  data = lgm_data, 
  control = control_settings,
  predictors = covariate_names
)

plot(kypd_tree)
summary(kypd_tree)
```

Something wrong...? in 'fair' method...?\
'score' method requires complete dataset... hence we need to run **imputation**.

`Error in fairSplit(node$model, mydata, control, invariance, meta, constraints = constraints, : no slot of name "data" for this object of class "lavaan"`

```{r Mplustrees}

library(MplusTrees)
library(MplusAutomation)

script = mplusObject(
  TITLE = 'KYPA LGM;',
  MODEL = 'i s | t1@0 t2@1 t3@2 t4@3 t5@4;',
  usevariables = c('t1','t2','t3','t4','t5'), 
  rdata = kypd)

fit.mplustree = MplusTrees(script, kypd, 
                           group=~STID, 
                           rPartFormula =~ x1 + x2 + x3, 
                           control=rpart.control(cp=.001, 
                                                 minbucket=20,
                                                 maxdepth=3))

fit.mplustree
plot(fit.mplustree)
summary(fit.mplustree)
```
